text: he hid as it were our faces from him: Or, he hid as it were his face from us. Heb. as a hiding of faces from him or from us
wounded: Or, tormented | stripes: Heb. bruise
laid on him the iniquity of us all: Heb. he hath made the iniquity of us all to meet on him
He was taken from prison, and from judgment: Or, he was taken away my distress and judgment, but etc. | was he stricken: Heb. was the stroke upon him
when thou shalt make his soul on offering: Or, when his soul shall make an offering
